verdict.rationale: Deepgram's Voice Agent API could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no way to plug external MCP servers in for the product to use. The dg CLI's built-in MCP server is the server role, where Deepgram exposes its own APIs to other AI tools, which is the opposite direction. Voice-agent function calling is an adjacent building block, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
